title: ResolutionResponse
description: Response payload returned by the verana indexer DID Resolver. Optional sections (`corporation`, `participations`, `ecsCredentials`, `presentations`, `services`, `ecosystems`) are present only when the corresponding selector was set in the request. The core fields (`did`, `trusted`, `evaluatedAtTime`, `evaluatedAtBlock`, `expiresAtTime`, `corporationId`) are always returned. The `vsOperator` account is surfaced **per Participant** (not at envelope level) because each `Participant` entry carries its own VS Operator Authorization grant. All datetime values are ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC strings (see `#/$defs/Iso8601DateTime`). See `### Example resolution response` in the indexer spec.

trusted.description: Whether the DID qualifies as a Verifiable Service per [VS-REQ] at the evaluation point-in-time.

expiresAtTime.description: Earliest future boundary at which the DID would cease to be trustable, computed per [IDX-VT-EVAL-2] as the minimum over the trust-evaluation inputs (`effective_until` of the anchoring Participant entries, `validUntil` of the ECS-SERVICE and anchor ECS-ORG/ECS-PERSONA credentials). `null` when no boundary exists — the evaluation then remains valid until a re-evaluation event per [IDX-VT-EVAL-3]. NOT a TTL relative to `evaluatedAtTime`.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation that owns this DID — the unique Corporation whose `did` equals the resolved DID, well-defined by VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant (at most one Corporation has any given DID). Always surfaced as part of the trust-core fields (not gated by any selector). Equals `corporation.id` whenever the `corporation` object is included.

corporation.description: The Corporation the DID *represents* (whose `did` equals the resolved DID). Singular per VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant. The Corporation's `did` is not repeated on the object (it is the envelope's resolved `did`). Omitted when the resolved DID is not the `did` of any Corporation.

Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets (e.g. `+02:00`), date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.

Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP.

DigestSri.description: Subresource Integrity digest in the standard `algo-base64` form.

ParticipantsByRole.description: Participant counts keyed by role. Roles with zero participants MAY be omitted.

Corporation.description: The response's `corporation` object: the unique Corporation whose `did` equals the resolved DID (per VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant). The `did` field is not repeated on the object (it is the envelope's resolved `did`). The Corporation's stable primary key is its `uint64` `id`; the on-chain account that signs on its behalf is surfaced separately as `policyAddress`.

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation entry (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`). MUST be globally unique across all Corporation entries. MAY be backed by any signing primitive (single key, multisig, Cosmos SDK group policy, …).

deposit.description: Trust deposit currently bonded by the Corporation.

lastSlashedAtTime.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent slash event affecting this Corporation.

cgf.description: Active Corporation Governance Framework. Mirrors the active `GovernanceFrameworkVersion` of this Corporation per the VPR data model. Omitted only when the Corporation has not yet published any GF.

Participant.description: A VPR `Participant` entry surfaced under the resolve response's `participations[]`. Every entry's `Participant.did` equals the envelope's resolved `did` (that is how the entry came to be included in this DID's participations[]); the `did` is therefore not repeated per entry, mirroring how the `corporation` object and `ecosystems[]` entries omit the envelope-shared `did`. The Corporation backing this Participant is envelope-derived: per VPR's per-Participant `(did, corporation_id)` consistency invariant, every Participant of a given DID shares the same controlling `corporation_id`; it is therefore not repeated per entry. The `vsOperator` account, by contrast, **is** surfaced per entry because each Participant's VS Operator Authorization grant is a distinct on-chain object — the controlling Corporation MAY authorise different operator accounts for different Participants. The graph keys this record by `id` (the stable VPR ledger id) rather than by a composite key. The referenced schema is surfaced as `credentialSchemaId` only — not as a full schema block — because by the time a Participant is reconciled, the corresponding `CredentialSchema` record has necessarily already been persisted by the graph from the controlling Ecosystem's own resolve. `ecosystemId` is a denormalisation provided for direct access; it is deterministically derivable from `credentialSchemaId` (every CredentialSchema is owned by exactly one Ecosystem). `validatorParticipantId` mirrors VPR's `validator_participant_id` and anchors the **permission delegation chain** — the upstream Participant under whose permission this entry was onboarded (the *parent node* in the Participant tree). It is surfaced always, with the explicit value `null` for `role = ECOSYSTEM` entries (the chain root) and a non-null `uint64` for every other role.

id.description: VPR `Participant.id` — stable ledger primary key. Used as the graph's `Participant` record identity.

vsOperator.description: Cosmos account address authorised (via VS Operator Authorization granted by the controlling Corporation — `Participant.corporation_id`) to act as the VS operator for this specific Participant entry. Different Participants under the same Corporation MAY carry different `vsOperator` accounts. Set at Participant creation and immutable thereafter.

credentialSchemaId.description: Stable VPR id of the referenced `CredentialSchema`. Anchors the `FOR_SCHEMA: Participant → CredentialSchema` edge.

ecosystemId.description: Stable VPR id of the Ecosystem that owns the referenced schema. Denormalisation for query convenience; derivable from `credentialSchemaId` via the `CredentialSchema ← Ecosystem` ownership 1:1.

validatorParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the **validator** Participant — the upstream Participant under whose permission this entry was onboarded (mirrors VPR `Participant.validator_participant_id`; the *parent node* in the Participant tree). Anchors the `VALIDATED_BY: Participant → Participant` graph edge. MUST be a non-negative integer for every role except `ECOSYSTEM`, and MUST be the explicit JSON value `null` when `role = ECOSYSTEM` (the chain root; an ECOSYSTEM Participant has no parent Participant — its validator is the Ecosystem entity itself, addressable via `ecosystemId`). The `null ↔ ECOSYSTEM` equivalence is enforced by the `allOf` block on this object.

EcsCredential.description: An ECS credential extracted from one of the DID's linked-VPs. The shape of `credentialSubject` is governed by the corresponding ECS schema (Service / Organization / Persona / UserAgent). `ecosystemId` (uint64) is the indexer's stable-identifier reference to the issuing ecosystem and is what the graph uses as the `GOVERNED_BY` edge anchor; the VC body's `ecosystem` DID claim is NOT surfaced inline (consumers needing it can fetch the VC body via the VP). `credentialSchemaId` (uint64) is the stable VPR id of the ECS schema; the (ecsSchema, ecsSchemaVersion) enum-pair is retained for type-based query. `participantId` (uint64) is the stable VPR id of the HOLDER `Participant` entry that tracks this credential's lifecycle; surfacing it inline lets consumers anchor a direct `HELD_AS: EcsCredential → Participant` edge without any JOIN. `issuerParticipantId` (uint64) is the stable VPR id of the ISSUER `Participant` entry under whose authority this credential was issued; surfacing it inline lets consumers anchor a direct `ISSUED_BY: EcsCredential → Participant` edge — the issuer's DID is recoverable as `Participant.did` of the referenced Participant entry, so the VC body's `issuer` DID claim is NOT surfaced inline.

credentialSchemaId.description: Stable VPR id of the `CredentialSchema` (ECS schema) that defines this credential's shape. Anchors the `BASED_ON_SCHEMA: EcsCredential → CredentialSchema` edge.

issuerParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the ISSUER `Participant` entry that issued this credential (role = ISSUER, credentialSchemaId = this credential's credentialSchemaId, did = issuer DID). Anchors the `ISSUED_BY: EcsCredential → Participant` edge by stable id; the issuer's DID is recoverable as `Participant.did` of that entry.

ecosystemId.description: Stable VPR ledger id of the issuing ecosystem. Anchors the `GOVERNED_BY: EcsCredential → Ecosystem` edge. The VC body's `ecosystem` DID claim is not surfaced inline (the stable id is sufficient for graph linking; consumers needing the original DID claim can fetch the VC body via the VP).

participantId.description: Stable VPR id of the HOLDER `Participant` entry that tracks this credential's lifecycle (issuance, validity, revocation, expiration). Anchors the `HELD_AS: EcsCredential → Participant` edge so consumers can resolve the participation directly without joining on (holder DID, credentialSchemaId, role=HOLDER).

validFrom.description: Start of the credential's validity window (mirrors the VC body's `validFrom`).

validUntil.description: End of the credential's validity window (mirrors the VC body's `validUntil`).

Presentation.description: Per-LinkedVerifiablePresentation outcome. `vtcCredentials` enumerates the non-ECS Verifiable Trust Credentials carried by the VP, each surfaced as a structured reference with stable VPR ids for the schema, issuing ecosystem, HOLDER Participant, and ISSUER Participant (the credential body itself stays in the VP and is not surfaced inline; ECS credentials are surfaced separately under `ecsCredentials[]` and are NOT repeated here). `unresolvableCredentialIds` and `invalidCredentialIds` appear only when the corresponding request flags are set.

vtcCredentials.description: One entry per non-ECS VTC carried by this VP. Each entry provides the credential's `id` plus stable VPR ids for its schema and issuing ecosystem, sufficient for the graph to materialise the credential as a separate entity and anchor edges by stable id.

id.description: The VTC's `id` (URN, did-URL fragment, or other credential identifier as carried by the VC body).

credentialSchemaId.description: Stable VPR id of the `CredentialSchema` that defines the credential's shape. Anchors a `BASED_ON_SCHEMA` edge.

ecosystemId.description: Stable VPR id of the Ecosystem under which the credential was issued. Anchors a `GOVERNED_BY` edge.

participantId.description: Stable VPR id of the HOLDER `Participant` entry that tracks this VTC's lifecycle. Anchors a `HELD_AS: Vtc → Participant` edge so consumers can resolve the participation directly without joining on (holder DID, credentialSchemaId, role=HOLDER).

issuerParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the ISSUER `Participant` entry that issued this VTC. Anchors a `ISSUED_BY: Vtc → Participant` edge; the issuer's DID is recoverable as `Participant.did` of that entry.

unresolvableCredentialIds.description: Observability-only flat list: credential ids the indexer could not resolve at all. No metadata available since resolution failed.

invalidCredentialIds.description: Observability-only flat list: credential ids the indexer found invalid (signature, format, expired, etc.). No metadata surfaced.

ServiceEndpoint.description: Non-LinkedVerifiablePresentation service entry from the DID Document, surfaced verbatim. The `serviceEndpoint` MAY be a string (simple URI) or an object (DIDComm composite shape, etc.). `accept` is included for service types that declare it (e.g. DIDComm).

Ecosystem.description: Aggregate metrics for an ecosystem the DID represents (`Ecosystem.did` equals the resolved DID, by the indexer's channel rule). The `did` field is not repeated per entry (envelope-derived from the response's resolved `did`). `corporationId` identifies the controlling Corporation per entry; per VPR's per-Ecosystem `(did, corporation_id)` consistency invariant, every Ecosystem with a given `did` shares the same controlling `corporation_id`, so all `ecosystems[i].corporationId` values within any single resolve response are necessarily equal. Surfaced per entry anyway for self-description and because the controlling Corporation MAY differ from the envelope-level `corporationId` (which identifies the Corporation that *owns* the DID per VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant) — the Corp owning a DID and the Corp controlling Ecosystems claiming that DID are not unified by any VPR invariant.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation that controls this Ecosystem (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`). Anchors the `CONTROLS: Corporation → Ecosystem` edge.

egf.description: Active Ecosystem Governance Framework. Mirrors the active `GovernanceFrameworkVersion` of this Ecosystem per the VPR data model. Omitted only when the Ecosystem has not yet published any GF.

EcosystemSchema.description: A schema embedded in an Ecosystem's `credentialSchemas[]` array. Identified by its stable VPR id (`id`); the URI form (`vpr:verana:<network>:cs:<id>`) is deterministic from `(network, id)` and is not repeated inline. The schema body is loaded out-of-band via the indexer's resource-load API by `id`.

id.description: Stable VPR ledger id of the schema. The sole identity used by the graph and by the indexer's schema-load API. Anchors `BASED_ON_SCHEMA`, `FOR_SCHEMA`, and `OWNS_SCHEMA` edges.

GovernanceFramework.description: Active Governance Framework (CGF on a Corporation, EGF on an Ecosystem). Flattens the active `GovernanceFrameworkVersion` from the VPR data model: one entry per published language for the active version, each pointing at the canonical document URL with a `digestSri` for relying-party integrity verification.

version.description: Currently active GF version number (mirrors `Corporation.active_version` / `Ecosystem.active_version` in VPR; MUST start with 1).

activeSince.description: Time at which this version became active (mirrors `GovernanceFrameworkVersion.active_since`). Optional but RECOMMENDED.

documents.description: One document per published language for the active GF version.

url.description: Canonical publication URL of the document.

digestSri.description: Subresource Integrity digest of the canonical document body, for integrity verification by relying parties.
